text.p: Integrated Health Services Inc and RoTech Medical Corp said Monday that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement.
Integrated will issue 0.5806 shares of common stock for each share of RoTech common stock currently outstanding, a news release issued by the companies said.
RoTech stockholders will get about $22.61 in value in integrated common stock for each share of RoTech common stock based on a fixed exchange rate, the news release said.
Integrated will issue about 15.8 million shares of common stock, the companies said.
The equity value of the acquisition is about $615 million, based on the exchange terms, the companies said.
The total value of the transaction, including the assumption of RoTech's debt by Integrated and other financial obligations, will be about $915 million, the companies said.
Integrated said the merger is expected to be immediately accretive to its earnings per share, the news release said.
